title: Golden Sun - The Lost Age
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 2592 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
struct layout shared with Golden Sun (RA game 767)
notes: Genre: RPG. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Felix (Venus), Jenna (Mars), Sheba (Jupiter), Piers (Mercury).
Isaac's party rejoins late in the game.
widgets.label: Adepts

widgets.text: Set Djinn of other elements to unlock hybrid classes.
widgets.label: Class

widgets.text:
72 Djinn across both games (this game adds 44).
Set / Standby / Recovery work as in the first game.
widgets.label: Djinn

widgets.text: Summon tablets hidden in the world teach new summons that need Djinn of several elements.
widgets.label: Summons

widgets.text:
Unleash Djinn, then summon with them for burst damage.
Optional bosses (Star Magician, Valukar, Sentinel, Dullahan) need full Djinn sets.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Roughly: Idejima -> Daila -> Madra -> Alhafra -> Gondowan -> the Great Sea by ship -> Lemuria -> Contigo and Jupiter Lighthouse -> Prox -> Mars Lighthouse.
widgets.label: Route

widgets.text: Piers' ship opens the Great Sea; the Hover and Wings let it cross shallows and fly over waves.
widgets.label: Ship

widgets.text:
15 slots per character. Sunshine forges again in Yallam with rare materials.
Find Psynergy items: Cyclone Chip, Hover Jade, Lash Pebble, Pound Cube, Scoop Gem, Sand...
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text:
Djinn hide in towns, dungeons and on the sea.
Some only appear as random battles in a set area (they flee).
widgets.label: Hunting

widgets.text: Tablets (e.g. Zagan, Megaera, Flora, Moloch, Haures, Coatlicue, Iris) sit in hidden or optional places: look for them after getting new Psynergy.
widgets.label: Summon tablets

widgets.text:
Gondowan cliffs -> Lemuria -> Jupiter Lighthouse -> Prox -> Mars Lighthouse (finale).
Post-game: Anemos Inner Sanctum and Dullahan.
widgets.label: Milestones
